title_en: Wei Tongbing v. Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. et al. — dispute over request for change of company registration
ruling_gist_en: The legal representative is the person in charge of a company who externally represents the company in civil activities, and the registration of the legal representative has the effect of public notice according to law. Internally, the relationship between the company and its legal representative is one of mandate, and the basis of the legal representative's authority to represent is the company's authorization, which is acquired upon appointment by the company and terminates upon removal. Once the company's authority removes the legal representative from his or her position in accordance with the company's articles of association, the representative authority of the legal representative is terminated.
keywords_en: civil; dispute over application for change of company registration; retrial; Supreme People's Court; Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; natural person; legal person; Company Law; obligation to change registration after removal of legal representative; termination of internal mandate relationship between company and legal representative; validity of shareholders' resolution; reversal of judgment; removal of legal representative; industrial and commercial registration change; shareholders' resolution; application for retrial; company; dispute over application for change of company registration
full_text_en:
Wei Tongbing v. Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., et al. — Dispute over Request for Change of Company Registration

【Ruling Summary】

The legal representative is the company officer who externally represents the company in engaging in civil activities, and the registration of the legal representative has, by law, the effect of public notice. Internally, the relationship between the company and its legal representative is one of mandate; the basis of the legal representative's authority to represent is the company's authorization, which is obtained upon appointment by the company and terminates upon dismissal. Once the company's authority removes the legal representative from office in accordance with the company's articles of association, the legal representative's authority to represent is terminated.

Where the shareholders' meeting of a limited liability company removes the legal representative from office in accordance with the articles of association, the company's executive body shall implement the company's resolution and, in accordance with the law, handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the company's legal representative.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2022) Supreme People's Court Civil Re-Trial No. 94

Re-trial Applicant (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Wei Tongbing, male, born December 9, 1968, Han nationality, residing in Fengtai District, Beijing.

Agent ad litem: Lei Jianhua, lawyer of Xinjiang Yuanzheng Shengye Law Firm.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 28, Yuxiuli-Tuanjie North Street, Kuitun City, Yili Prefecture, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

Legal Representative: Wei Tongbing, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Xinjiang Baota Investment Holding Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 201, 2nd Floor, Building 1, No. 238 Kunming Road, High-tech Zone (New Urban District), Urumqi City, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

Legal Representative: Tie Bin, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Xinjiang Jiahong Investment Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 1, 22nd Floor, Building A, Hengfu Building, Wenyi Road, Tianshan District, Urumqi City, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

Legal Representative: Cui Feng, General Manager of the company.

The re-trial applicant, Wei Tongbing, dissatisfied with the civil judgment (2021) Ning Min Zhong No. 82 rendered by the High People's Court of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region in the dispute over request for change of company registration against the respondents, Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Baota Real Estate Company), Xinjiang Baota Investment Holding Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Baota Investment Company), and Xinjiang Jiahong Investment Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jiahong Company), applied to this Court for retrial. This Court, by civil ruling (2021) Supreme People's Court Civil Shen No. 7049 dated December 17, 2021, decided to retry this case. This Court formed a collegial panel according to law and held a hearing in this case. The re-trial applicant Wei Tongbing and his agent ad litem Lei Jianhua appeared in court. The respondents Baota Real Estate Company and Baota Investment Company, after being legally summoned by this Court, failed to appear in court without justifiable reasons. The respondent Jiahong Company stated in writing that it would not participate in the proceedings. The trial of this case has now been concluded.

Wei Tongbing's retrial requests: 1. To revoke the civil judgment (2021) Ning Min Zhong No. 82 rendered by the High People's Court of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region in accordance with the law, and to modify the judgment to order Baota Real Estate Company to handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the company's legal representative for Wei Tongbing, with Baota Investment Company and Jiahong Company providing cooperation. 2. To order Baota Real Estate Company, Baota Investment Company, and Jiahong Company to bear the retrial costs. Facts and reasons: (1) The labor relationship between Wei Tongbing and Baota Real Estate Company no longer exists, and the basis and conditions for Wei Tongbing to continue serving as the legal representative of Baota Real Estate Company have been lost. On July 18, 2017, the President's Office of Baota Petrochemical Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Baota Petrochemical Group) issued Baozongfa [2017] No. 63 "Decision on Dismissal of Cadres", dismissing Wei Tongbing from all positions in Baota Real Estate Company, including Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative, and in Baota Petrochemical Group. On July 20, 2017, Baota Investment Company, the controlling shareholder of Baota Real Estate Company, notified Wei Tongbing of the dismissal and informed him that the dismissal decision had been notified to Jiahong Company, which accepted and agreed to the dismissal decision. Therefore, since July 18, 2017, Wei Tongbing's mandate to serve as the legal representative of Baota Real Estate Company has been terminated. In fact, after being dismissed, Wei Tongbing has been suspended from all positions and work in Baota Petrochemical Group and Baota Real Estate Company, has not received any remuneration from Baota Petrochemical Group, and has no connection with Baota Real Estate Company. According to the provisions of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the legal representative of a company shall be the chairman of the board, executive director, or manager. That is to say, for a natural person to become the legal representative of a company, there must be a substantive interest relationship with the company, which is the premise and origin for serving as the legal representative. Therefore, Wei Tongbing has lost the legal basis and basic conditions for serving as the legal representative of Baota Real Estate Company. Baota Real Estate Company should, in principle, handle the change of registration of the legal representative for Wei Tongbing. Where Baota Real Estate Company made the dismissal decision regarding Wei Tongbing, and Wei Tongbing left the company and terminated the labor relationship between the parties, Baota Real Estate Company's inaction and refusal to change the registration of the legal representative for Wei Tongbing have harmed Wei Tongbing's rights and interests. (2) The shareholders of Baota Real Estate Company reached a consensus on dismissing Wei Tongbing as Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative, which has already produced the legal effect of a shareholders' meeting resolution. After Baota Petrochemical Group issued the "Decision on Dismissal of Cadres", Baota Investment Company notified Jiahong Company, and Jiahong Company agreed. The defense opinion submitted by Jiahong Company to the court during the second instance trial also confirmed the above facts. Due to Baota Investment Company's delay and subsequent overall takeover, the change of registration of Wei Tongbing's legal representative could not be completed, and Wei Tongbing could not obtain the internal shareholders' meeting resolution of Baota Real Estate Company. However, in conjunction with the "Notice of Dismissal" issued by Baota Investment Company and the defense opinion submitted by Jiahong Company, in fact, the two shareholders of Baota Real Estate Company have reached a consensus on dismissing Wei Tongbing as legal representative, producing the legal effect of a shareholders' meeting resolution. Therefore, it should be determined in accordance with the law that the dismissal of Wei Tongbing as legal representative is the common intention of the two shareholders. (3) Wei Tongbing has exhausted the internal remedies of the company. After being dismissed, because he has no investment relationship with the company and no longer works for Baota Petrochemical Group, as a former employee, he cannot convene a shareholders' meeting or use other corporate autonomy channels to make resolutions on changing the legal representative and provide corresponding evidence materials. Moreover, the company's articles of association do not include provisions regarding the change of registration of the legal representative. Under such circumstances, Wei Tongbing requested Baota Petrochemical Group and Baota Real Estate Company to handle the change of registration, but the request was ignored. Wei Tongbing was forced to continue being a "nominal" legal representative of Baota Real Estate Company, which has seriously harmed his interests. Therefore, he filed a lawsuit with the court, requesting legal protection of his rights and interests.

Jiahong Company submitted a written opinion, stating that it acknowledges the facts alleged by Wei Tongbing in the lawsuit and also agrees that the company handle the industrial and commercial change of registration for Wei Tongbing.

Wei Tongbing's claims at the first instance: 1. To order Baota Real Estate Company to handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the company's legal representative, with Baota Investment Company and Jiahong Company providing cooperation; 2. To order Baota Real Estate Company, Baota Investment Company, and Jiahong Company to bear the litigation costs, mailing fees, and other related expenses of this case.

The facts found by the court of first instance: Baota Real Estate Company was established on March 26, 2013, with a registered capital of RMB 20 million. Baota Investment Company and Jiahong Company are its shareholders, with Baota Investment Company subscribing for RMB 19 million and Jiahong Company subscribing for RMB 1 million. Wei Tongbing served as the Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative of Baota Real Estate Company. Baota Investment Company, established on December 6, 2012, is a wholly-owned corporate sole proprietorship of Baota Investment Holding Co., Ltd.

The court of first instance rendered a judgment: Dismissing all of Wei Tongbing's claims. The first instance case acceptance fee of RMB 100 and the announcement fee of RMB 560 were all borne by Wei Tongbing.

Wei Tongbing, dissatisfied with the first instance judgment, appealed with the following requests: 1. To revoke the civil judgment (2019) Ning 01 Min Chu No. 3717 in accordance with the law, and to modify the judgment to order Baota Real Estate Company to handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the company's legal representative within a specified period, with Baota Investment Company and Jiahong Company providing cooperation; 2. To order Baota Real Estate Company, Baota Investment Company, and Jiahong Company to bear the litigation costs of the first and second instances.

During the second instance, Wei Tongbing submitted the original copy of Baota Petrochemical Group's President's Office's Baozongfa [2017] No. 63 "Decision on Dismissal of Cadres" dated July 18, 2017, and the original "Notice of Dismissal" issued by Baota Investment Company dated July 20, 2017.

Baota Real Estate Company, Baota Investment Company, and Jiahong Company did not appear in court during the second instance.

The facts found by the second instance were consistent with those of the first instance.

The court of second instance held that a party should provide evidence to prove the facts on which its claims are based. Article 13 of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "The legal representative of a company shall, in accordance with the provisions of the company's articles of association, be the chairman, executive director, or manager, and shall be registered according to law. Where the legal representative of the company is changed, the change of registration shall be handled." In this case, Wei Tongbing did not submit the articles of association of Baota Real Estate Company, and thus could not prove the company's provisions on the appointment and dismissal of the legal representative. He also did not submit valid evidence that Baota Real Estate Company had made a resolution or decision to change the registration of the legal representative. Baota Investment Company and Jiahong Company did not refuse to handle the change of registration. Wei Tongbing's claims did not comply with the relevant provisions of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China. In conclusion, the court of second instance held that Wei Tongbing's appeal grounds could not be established and should be dismissed. The first instance judgment had clear findings of fact and correct application of law, and should be affirmed. Pursuant to Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended in 2017), the judgment was: Appeal dismissed, and the original judgment affirmed. The second instance case acceptance fee of RMB 100 was borne by Wei Tongbing.

During the retrial, Wei Tongbing submitted two copies of the "Articles of Association of Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd." stamped with dates of March 25, 2013, and August 17, 2017, to prove that, in accordance with Article 13 of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 26 of the company's articles of association, Wei Tongbing had been removed from the positions of Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative, and no longer met the requirements for continuing to serve as legal representative. Therefore, Baota Real Estate Company is obligated to handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the legal representative.

Upon examination, the two copies of the articles of association bore the special seal of the Registration Archives Inquiry of the Market Supervision Administration of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and this Court confirms that the two copies of the articles of association are authentic.

This Court found during the retrial: The "Articles of Association of Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd." filed with the industrial and commercial registration authority on March 25, 2013, provides in Article 13: "The shareholders' meeting is composed of all shareholders and is the authority of the company, exercising the following powers: ... (2) To elect and replace directors and supervisors who are not representatives of the employees, and to decide on the remuneration of such directors and supervisors ..." Article 19 provides: "The company shall establish a board of directors consisting of 5 members, with 3 members appointed by Xinjiang Baota Investment Holding Co., Ltd. and 2 members appointed by Xinjiang Jiahong Investment Co., Ltd. The term of office of directors is 3 years, and they may be re-elected upon expiration of their terms. The board of directors shall have one chairman, elected by the board of directors. The term of office of the chairman is 3 years, and upon expiration, he may be re-elected. The board of directors is responsible to the shareholders' meeting and exercises the following powers: ... (2) To implement the resolutions of the shareholders' meeting ..." Article 26 provides: "The chairman of the board shall be the legal representative of the company." The articles of association of Baota Real Estate Company dated August 17, 2017, are substantially consistent with the above content of the articles of association dated March 25, 2013.

Separately, it was found that on July 20, 2017, Baota Investment Company issued a "Notice of Dismissal" stating: "Wei Tongbing: In accordance with the office document Baozongfa [2017] No. 63 of Baota Petrochemical Group, we hereby notify you that you are removed from the positions of Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative of Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., and also from the position of General Manager of Xinjiang Baota Petrochemical Transportation Company. As the controlling shareholder of Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., we have the right to decide on the appointment and removal of the chairman and legal representative of the company. We have notified the other shareholder, Xinjiang Jiahong Investment Co., Ltd., of our decision to remove you, and that company has not raised any objection. This notice shall take effect from the date of issuance."

During the retrial, it was also found that the series of financial cases involving Baota Petrochemical Group are ongoing. Baota Investment Company and Baota Real Estate Company are both subsidiaries of Baota Petrochemical Group.

During the retrial hearing, this Court contacted Baota Petrochemical Group and sent it a letter informing it of the litigation matters of Wei Tongbing in this case, suggesting that Baota Petrochemical Group coordinate and handle Wei Tongbing's related claims. Baota Petrochemical Group did not respond after receiving the letter from this Court.

The other facts found by this Court during the retrial are consistent with those of the first and second instances.

This Court held in the retrial: Pursuant to Article 1, Paragraph 2 of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China in Terms of Temporal Effect", which states: "For civil dispute cases arising from legal facts occurring before the implementation of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the laws and judicial interpretations in effect at that time shall apply, unless the law or judicial interpretation provides otherwise." The disputed facts in this case occurred before the implementation of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, so the laws and judicial interpretations in effect at that time shall apply. The issue in dispute in this case is whether Baota Real Estate Company should handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the company's legal representative for Wei Tongbing.

Based on the facts found in this case, this Court holds that Baota Real Estate Company should handle the industrial and commercial change of registration of the company's legal representative for Wei Tongbing, for the following reasons:

(I) Baota Real Estate Company has terminated the mandate relationship with Wei Tongbing as legal representative, and Wei Tongbing no longer has the legal basis to represent the company.

The legal representative is one of the organs that externally represent the company's will. A registered legal representative has, by law, the effect of public notice. However, internally, the relationship between the company and its legal representative is one of mandate. The basis for the legal representative to exercise the power of representation is the authorization granted by the company's authority. When the company's authority terminates the authorization, the legal representative's power to externally represent the company in civil activities is also terminated, and the company shall promptly handle the industrial and commercial change of registration.

In this case, Article 13 of the "Articles of Association of Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd." provides that the shareholders' meeting of Baota Real Estate Company is the authority of the company and has the power to elect and replace directors. Article 19 provides that directors are appointed by shareholders, the board of directors is responsible to the shareholders' meeting and implements its resolutions, and the chairman is elected by the board of directors. Article 26 provides that the chairman is the legal representative of the company. On March 26, 2013, Baota Real Estate Company was established. Wei Tongbing was a director appointed by Baota Investment Company, a shareholder of Baota Real Estate Company, and was elected as chairman by the board of directors in accordance with the articles of association. He served as the legal representative of the company in accordance with the articles of association and was registered with the industrial and commercial authorities. Therefore, Wei Tongbing served as the legal representative of the company by mandate from the company's authority.

On July 18, 2017, Baota Petrochemical Group issued the "Decision on Dismissal of Cadres", dismissing Wei Tongbing from the positions of Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative of Baota Real Estate Company. On July 20, 2017, Baota Investment Company, in accordance with the above decision of Baota Petrochemical Group, issued a "Notice of Dismissal" to Wei Tongbing, removing him from the positions of Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative of the company. The "Notice of Dismissal" also stated: "As the controlling shareholder of Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., we have the right to decide on the appointment and removal of the chairman and legal representative of the company. We have notified the other shareholder, Xinjiang Jiahong Investment Co., Ltd., of our decision to remove you, and that company has not raised any objection. This notice shall take effect from the date of issuance." After being dismissed, Wei Tongbing did not work for the company and did not receive any remuneration from the company. During the proceedings of this case, Jiahong Company explicitly stated that it was aware of and agreed to the company's decision. Therefore, it can be determined that the two shareholders of Baota Real Estate Company have passed a shareholders' meeting resolution to dismiss Wei Tongbing and have notified Wei Tongbing of the same. This resolution complies with the provisions of Baota Real Estate Company's articles of association, does not violate the law, and has legal effect. The mandate relationship between the parties has been terminated, and Wei Tongbing no longer holds the duties of the legal representative of the company. Pursuant to Article 13 of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, which provides: "The legal representative of a company shall, in accordance with the provisions of the company's articles of association, be the chairman, executive director, or manager, and shall be registered according to law. Where the legal representative of the company is changed, the change of registration shall be handled." Baota Real Estate Company shall, in accordance with the law, handle the change of registration of the legal representative.

(II) Baota Real Estate Company has failed to perform its obligations, causing harm to Wei Tongbing's rights and interests. Therefore, it shall handle the change of registration of the legal representative.

According to Article 6 of the "Provisions on the Administration of Registration of Enterprise Legal Representatives" (amended in 1999) formulated by the former State Administration for Industry and Commerce, which states: "For an enterprise legal person to apply for the change of registration of its legal representative, it shall submit the following documents to the original enterprise registration authority: (1) a document removing the original legal representative; (2) a document appointing the new legal representative; (3) an application for change of registration signed by the original legal representative or the proposed legal representative." And Article 7: "A limited liability company or joint stock company that changes its legal representative shall convene a meeting of the shareholders' meeting, the general meeting of shareholders, or the board of directors to pass a resolution ..." According to these provisions, Baota Real Estate Company only needs to submit an application, a document removing the original legal representative, a document appointing the new legal representative, and a resolution passed by the shareholders' meeting, the general meeting of shareholders, or the board of directors to handle the industrial and commercial change of registration on its own. In this case, after Wei Tongbing was dismissed, he personally did not have the subject qualification to apply for the change of registration of the legal representative. Baota Real Estate Company also failed to submit an application and related documents to the local industrial and commercial bureau where the company is registered, resulting in Wei Tongbing still being publicly registered and published as the legal representative of the company after his dismissal. This, among other things, led to Wei Tongbing being restricted from high consumption in related lawsuits involving Baota Real Estate Company, which has caused actual impact on Wei Tongbing's life and infringed upon his lawful rights and interests. Apart from filing this lawsuit, Wei Tongbing has no other remedy. Therefore, Wei Tongbing's request for Baota Real Estate Company to handle the industrial and commercial change of registration is legally supported and should be granted. As to whether Baota Real Estate Company will select a new legal representative after this judgment is rendered, that falls within the scope of corporate autonomy, and this Court will not address it in this case.

In conclusion, the first and second instance judgments erred in dismissing Wei Tongbing's claims on the grounds that Baota Real Estate Company had not passed a resolution, etc. This Court hereby corrects that error in accordance with the law.

Additionally, Baota Investment Company and Jiahong Company are merely shareholders of Baota Real Estate Company, and they have already passed a resolution to remove Wei Tongbing as legal representative. They are not, by law, the entities obligated to handle the change of registration. Wei Tongbing's request for these two companies to handle or assist in handling the industrial and commercial change of registration of the legal representative lacks legal basis and is not supported.

In summary, Wei Tongbing's retrial requests are partially sustained. Pursuant to Article 13 of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 214, Paragraph 1 and Article 177, Paragraph 1, Item (2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Revoke the civil judgment (2021) Ning Min Zhong No. 82 of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court and the civil judgment (2019) Ning 01 Min Chu No. 3717 of the Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region;

2. Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. shall, within thirty days from the effective date of this judgment, complete the change of registration of the company's legal representative for Wei Tongbing;

3. Reject the other claims of Wei Tongbing.

The court acceptance fee of RMB 100 for the first instance, the announcement fee of RMB 560, and the court acceptance fee of RMB 100 for the second instance shall all be borne by Xinjiang Baota Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.

This judgment is final.
